title: Assigned Numbers: RFC 1700 is Replaced by an On-line Database

claims_extracted.claim: RFC 3232 formally obsoletes RFC 1700 and states that the periodic Assigned Numbers RFC series had been replaced by an online IANA database.
RFC 3232 describes RFC 1700 as an October 1994 snapshot and warns that its values are incomplete and may be wrong compared with the live database.

notes: Primary evidence for the institutional/publication transition from periodic RFC snapshots to live registries.
